item.title: Thousands face another arctic blast without power as East Coast preps for a storm
item.description: NASHVILLE — Frustrations were bubbling up Friday for the tens of thousands who have been without power for nearly a week in the U.S. South as a new storm looms, including Tennessee’s residents in Nashville, where the utility was criticized for storm preparations and recovery.

item.title: 2026 Clarks Summit Festival of Ice kicks off with Friday night parade, will run through Sunday
item.description: CLARKS SUMMIT — The 22nd Annual Clarks Summit Festival of Ice, themed “The American Dream: Carved in Ice,” kicked off Friday with live ice carvings, an evening parade, and other activities throughout the downtown. The event, presented by the Abington Business and Professional Association and sponsored by various local businesses and organizations, will continue through Sunday.

item.title: Local roundup: Holy Redeemer boys basketball edges Wyoming Seminary
item.description: Charlie Schaffer scored 16 points as Holy Redeemer edged Wyoming Seminary 44-38 Friday night to stay alive for the Wyoming Valley Conference Division 2 boys basketball crown.

item.title: Letter to the Editor: January 31, 2026
item.description: I am an American. I was born in this country. Both my parents were born in this country. I cannot say the same for my grandparents. It’s a familiar immigrant story. An American tale. I am living the American dream.

item.description: The RootsTech schedule is out. Take a look and see which of the scores of free talks and tutorials will best help you make progress in your genealogy.

item.title: American Water Charitable Foundation awards $50,000 to Greater W-B Chamber
item.description: The Greater Wilkes-Barre Chamber of Business & Industry recently was awarded a $50,000 2025 American Water Charitable Foundation Workforce Readiness Grant, focusing on general career readiness, financial and business literacy, positive youth development, and life skills training for the organization’s Luzerne Learns to Work Program.
